description: This is a unit test class for the 'ThingModified' event class, testing its immutability, JSON serialization/deserialization, and equality properties.

classes.name: ThingModifiedTest
classes.description: Unit tests for the ThingModified class, verifying immutability, JSON conversion, equality, and exception handling.

methods.name: assertImmutability
methods.description: Checks that the ThingModified class is immutable and that Thing instances are also immutable.

methods.name: testHashCodeAndEquals
methods.description: Verifies the correctness of hashCode and equals implementations using EqualsVerifier.

methods.name: tryToCreateInstanceWithNullThing
methods.description: Ensures that passing a null Thing to the factory method throws a NullPointerException.

methods.name: toJsonReturnsExpected
methods.description: Tests that the toJson method produces the expected JSON output.

methods.name: createInstanceFromValidJson
methods.description: Tests instantiation of ThingModified from valid JSON and checks property accessors.
